--- text
ca̲|t
--- keys
Left
--- expect
c|a̲t
--- note
The backward twin of fixture 27. Motion bugs are frequently one-directional, so
Left across a combining-mark cluster must be asserted separately from Right.

The middle glyph is "a" followed by U+0332 (COMBINING LOW LINE): two code units,
one extended grapheme cluster (UAX#29 GB9). The caret starts after the combining
mark (offset 3, before "t"). One ArrowLeft runs find-cluster-break backward,
which counts the combining mark as part of the "a" cluster and lands at offset
1, before "a". It must not stop at offset 2, between the combining mark and its
base, which would sit inside a single rendered glyph.
